_comment: Short names for `python -m fl_tools experiment <name>` (local, Ollama) and `csc/submit.sh <name>` (CSC Roihu, vLLM). 'family' is matched against the models Ollama has installed (e.g. qwen2.5-coder matches qwen2.5-coder:latest); num_ctx is applied by creating a variant automatically. 'hf' is the Hugging Face repo vLLM serves on CSC (unquantized weights; Ollama's default tags are 4-bit quantized, so local and CSC results of the same preset are not identical).

qwen35.note: newer Qwen; may 'think' before answering (slow, can use up the token budget). extra_body tries to switch thinking off; preflight warns if replies come back empty. Try --n 10 first. No 'hf' yet: fill in the exact Hugging Face repo id before using it on CSC.

llama31.note: general-purpose Llama 3.1 8B, the comparison point from the FlexFL paper. On CSC the HF repo is gated: accept the license on huggingface.co and set HF_TOKEN before downloading.

qwen25coder32.note: larger coder model, meant for CSC (about 65 GB of weights; fits one GH200 with 95 GB). Locally only if `ollama pull qwen2.5-coder:32b` and enough VRAM.
